en: Sepia-toned postcard showing an elderly man in formal 19th‑century clothing seated in an armchair in a study or living room. He rests his head on one hand, facing left, beside a table with a patterned cloth and papers. Behind him are bookcases filled with books and walls covered with framed pictures and artworks; small statues stand on top of the bookcase. The scene is indoors and intimate, presented as a historic photograph. Printed text appears along the bottom border.
